# Safe code review: `c82ccf0...bbadffe` (wa-2892/design-inconsistencies) Mode: committed range only, as you asked. Read-only: I edited no files, ran no tests and posted nothing. I didn't write `.git/safe-code-review/last-run.tsv`, so there is no "since last run" section. **Scope:** 39 files, +371 −100 · base `c82ccf0` → HEAD `bbadffe` (committed, working tree not included) **Profile:** safe-wallet monorepo · TypeScript/React (Next.js web, plus the `packages/theme` palette) · jest · tsc/eslint/prettier gates · stated rules come from AGENTS.md (theme tokens, "never edit vars.css directly", tests required, sentence case) | | | |---|---| | **Verdict** | Fix finding 1 before opening the PR | | **Score** | 86 / 100 (my estimate, adjudicated 3 of 5) | | **Held back by** | The new "keep the safe bar lit above the dropdown backdrop" code probably never works, and a shared colour token was changed app-wide | | **Fix first** | #1: an ancestor of `SpaceSafeBar` creates its own stacking context, which traps the bar under the backdrop | ## Scores by area (worst first) | Area | Score | Notes | |---|---|---| | Bugs | 78 | #1 (P2), #3 (P3) | | Regression | 85 | #2 (P2) | | Testing | 85 | #4 (P2) | | DRY | 95 | #5 (P3) | | Security, Architecture, Performance, KISS, Conventions | 100 | Checked, nothing filed (see below) | ## Must fix before opening **1. The safe bar's lift above the backdrop is trapped by the `@container` header** (P2, bugs, both agents confirmed it from the code, confidence about 65) - **Where:** `apps/web/src/components/common/SpaceSafeBar/index.tsx:296` and `apps/web/src/components/common/PageLayout/styles.module.css:30`. The blocking element is `apps/web/src/components/common/Header/Topbar/index.tsx:98`. - **What:** `.topbarAboveOverlay { z-index: auto }` removes the topbar wrapper's stacking context so the bar's `z-[calc(var(--z-overlay)+1)]` can beat the Select backdrop. That backdrop is at `z-[var(--z-overlay)]`, portaled into the `.shadcn-scope` root (`ShadcnProvider.tsx:48`, `_app.tsx:170`). - **Why it fails:** `SpaceSafeBar` renders inside `
`. `container-type: inline-size` applies layout containment, and layout containment always creates a stacking context. So the bar's z-index only counts inside the header, and the whole header paints below the backdrop at z 1400. - **Result:** when the safe-selector dropdown opens, the entire topbar is dimmed, including the trigger. That is exactly what `useTopbarOverlayElevation` / `useIsTopbarAboveOverlay` were added to prevent. - **Check first:** both agents worked this out from the code and the CSS spec, not in a browser. Before changing anything, open the dropdown in Chrome and Safari. If the bar is dimmed, move the `@container` onto an element that doesn't wrap the bar, or put the lift on the header itself. ## Worth a ticket or a fix in this PR | # | Pri | Area | Where | What | |---|---|---|---|---| | 2 | P2 | Regression | `apps/web/src/styles/shadcn.css:34` (and `:78`) | The shared shadcn `--accent` token changed from neutral `#f5f5f5` to green `#f0fdf4` in light mode (dark: `#12ff8033` → `#052e16`) to restyle three Spaces surfaces. `--accent` is also the hover/focus background of every item in `components/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx:119`, `context-menu.tsx:121`, `select.tsx:158`, `combobox.tsx:153`, and in global search (`AccountsSection.tsx:42`, `NavigateToSection.tsx:154`). Every menu highlight in light mode turns green, and nothing overrides it. If that's intended, say so in the PR. If not, add a scoped token. Both agents confirmed this. | | 3 | P3 | Bugs | `apps/web/src/features/multichain/components/NetworkLogosList/styles.module.css:19` | The mask applies to `span:not(:last-child)`, but `.networks` uses `flex-wrap: wrap`. The last logo on each wrapped row gets a crescent cut out with no neighbour covering it. Two consumers don't cap the list: `ReviewStep/index.tsx:145` and `CounterfactualSuccessScreen/index.tsx:122`. Fallback `SvgIcon` logos (no ``) are never masked. Both agents confirmed this. | | 4 | P2 | Testing | `apps/web/src/hooks/useTopbarElevation.ts:54-81`, `SafeSelectorDropdown/index.tsx:104`, `components/ui/select.tsx:109` | No test covers `useTopbarOverlayElevation` / `useIsTopbarAboveOverlay`, or that the modal and overlay stores stay separate. `hooks/__tests__/useTopbarElevation.test.ts` only exercises the modal pair. Nothing tests that the dropdown registers only when actually open (not when disabled or when `canOpen` is false), and nothing tests `showBackdrop`. If you remove line 104, no test fails. | | 5 | P3 | DRY | `SafeSelectorDropdown/components/SafeRowStats.tsx:10-15` vs `NetworkLogosList/styles.module.css:13-25` | The same stacked-logo crescent geometry is written twice: an inline constant and a CSS rule. The comments reference each other ("replicates … exactly"). The SafeRowStats comment says "12px logo radius", but the logo is 22px (`ChainLogo.tsx:8`), so the radius is 11px. | ## Not sure about these - `SpaceSafeContextMenu.tsx:37,83`: anchoring to `closest('tr')` and right alignment now apply to every consumer, including non-table ones (`SafeListItem.tsx:83`, `MultiAccountItem.tsx:164`, `SafeCardReadOnly.tsx:196`). The fallback prevents a crash, but menu placement changes there. Probably fine; I didn't check it in a browser. - If `.topbarElevated` (sticky) and the overlay are ever active together, sticky creates its own stacking context, which would also defeat the lift. In practice that's unlikely. ## Ruled out - `text-green-500` in `SpacesList/AccountInfo.tsx:28`: the repo already uses raw green utilities in about 10 places (`AccountsWidget.tsx:53`, `SetupWidget`, …), so this isn't a convention break. - The `vars.css` edit: it matches the new `lightHover` palette entries in `packages/theme` (light and dark, lowercase as generated). The added `ColorPalette` field has no other implementers that could break. - `calc(var(--z-overlay)+1)` without spaces: Tailwind normalises math operators in arbitrary values. ## Not checked - Nothing was rendered in a browser, which matters most for #1 and #3. - I didn't confirm `Select.Backdrop` exists in `@base-ui/react ^1.1.0` because `node_modules` isn't installed; type-check will catch it if it doesn't. - Mobile use of the new palette key. - Snapshot content in `NetworkLogosList.stories.test.tsx.snap`. ## Worth tidying (no score impact) 1. If you touch #5 anyway, replace the `SafeRowStats` constant with a CSS-variable-driven class like the one in `NetworkLogosList`, and fix the radius comment. About 10 lines. Fix now, ticket, or skip? Saying nothing counts as skip. ## How this was produced I did the category passes myself from the full diff instead of spawning nine reviewer agents. I adjudicated #1, #2 and #3 with paired validator and refuter agents: the validators confirmed all three, and the refuters couldn't break any of them. #4 and #5 are direct factual checks and weren't adjudicated, so they count at full weight. I estimated the scores with the review-context deduction model and didn't run `review-score` separately.
